blocks.text: Magnesium hydroxide (Mg(OH)₂, "Milk of Magnesia") maide (stomach) ke zaid tezaab ko neutralize (khatam) karne aur halke julaab (mild laxative) ke taur par istemal hota hai. Yeh bohat kam ghulta hai, is liye istemal ke liye mehfooz hai. Calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) bhi bad-hazmi (indigestion) ki goliyon mein antacid ke taur par istemal hota hai. Calcium compounds (calcium carbonate, calcium citrate waghera) mazboot haddiyon aur daanton ke liye zaroori hain aur osteoporosis (haddiyon ki kamzori) se bachane ke liye calcium supplements ke taur par aam istemal hote hain. Magnesium compounds (magnesium sulphate, magnesium citrate waghera) muscles aur nerves (asaab) ke kaam ke liye ahem hain aur magnesium ki kami ke ilaaj mein istemal hote hain.

Epsom salts (MgSO₄·7H₂O) julaab ke taur par aur nahane ke paani mein istemal hote hain. Barium sulphate (BaSO₄) "barium meals" mein istemal hota hai, jin se nizam-e-hazma (digestive system) ki X-ray tasveer li jati hai. X-rays is mein se nahi guzarti (yeh opaque hai), aur yeh mehfooz hai kyunke yeh bilkul nahi ghulta aur jism mein jazb hue baghair guzar jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Mg(OH)₂ aur CaCO₃ basic hain, is liye maide ke HCl ko neutralize karte hain: Mg(OH)₂ + 2HCl → MgCl₂ + 2H₂O. Barium ke ghule hue ions zehreele hote hain, magar BaSO₄ itna kam ghulta hai ke ions ban hi nahi pate.

blocks.prompt: Barium ions zehreele hain, phir bhi barium sulphate X-ray ke liye khilaya jata hai. Yeh mehfooz kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: BaSO₄ bohat hi kam ghulta hai (9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g paani, Table 17.4), is liye taqreeban koi Ba²⁺ ion ghul kar jism mein jazb nahi hota; yeh bas aanton se guzar jata hai.

items: Mg(OH)₂ (milk of magnesia) aur CaCO₃: antacids.
Calcium compounds haddiyon aur daanton ke liye; magnesium compounds muscles aur nerves ke liye.
Epsom salts (MgSO₄·7H₂O) julaab; na ghulne wala BaSO₄ barium meals mein.
